representation: Official StackedHistogram, 10 bins per polarity per step; native pixels; fastmode=False to prevent uint8 overflow; cutoff 255; zero bottom padding to512x640; no RGB
state: Reset all LSTM states at each query, retain only within the same 180ms window; detect only final step
classes: Official 1Mpx: 0 pedestrian, 1 two-wheeler, 2 car. Argmax over all three before retaining common classes; map 2 to car=0, 0 to pedestrian=1
comparison: Different pretraining data, architecture and encoding; raw history and native evaluation population shared. Diagnostic reference, not a controlled ANN-vs-SNN superiority experiment.
training_deviation: Official checkpoint uses 50ms steps and longer recurrent stream; here three60ms steps are a deliberately bounded-history transfer condition, not official benchmark reproduction
